macros.description: Version checks, custom settings, CICERS integration, service selection, and startup fallbacks.
Save slots, reload, reset, persistent mission presets, and aircraft profile persistence.
Aircraft setup, boarding, engines, fuel, weights, audio and crew configuration.
Tablet checklists of flight manual section 4 (interior check to engine shut-down, IFR procedures), their main page and hand-over macros.
Payload station weights: seat LVAR presence, hoist flags and kit masses recomputed by the thread STATION WEIGHTS.
Debug Center plus CARLS Direction Finder controls, renderer, and persistent DF-station database UI.
Tablet pages, settings, mission lists, debug UI, CARLS controls, and keypad events.
Nation/accident-location queries, positional and proximity node queries, hospital/helipad transfer lists, and ambulance/user destination selection.
Procedural point-of-interest and terrain location generators (camping, hiking, roads, train/bus stops, buildings, natural features) used by scene generation.
Random scene assets, incidents, people, vehicles, VFX, SAR scenes, and accident profiles.
Patient generation, physiology, clinical workflows, LifeScore, CPR, identity, and multi-patient state.
Ambulance, police, fire, road travel, parking, clinical handover, and secondary rescue.
Hoist state, skid/ground operations, heli-rescuer choreography, and crew return to aircraft.
Patient and organ transfers, ELT, special mission launch, midway loading, and destination arrival.
Dispatch lifecycle, objectives, report submission, cancellation, return-to-base, and RescueTrack updates.
Base, hospital, and technical marshaller creation, snapshots, guidance, and animations.
Crew LifeScore, environmental impact, fatal replacement, emergency recovery, and care routing.
Shared repeated blocks and small runtime helpers not owned by a narrower subsystem.
Generic patient registry, triage, exclusive transport reservations, CPR leases, and scene access paths.
HEMS patient selection by lowest current LifeScore among patients not already transported by ground.
Automatic location-change history and road-node recovery diagnostics.
Reviewed runtime overrides preserving descent-rate safety behavior during semantic merge.

data.description: Debug, mission preset, aircraft profile, and DF-station persistent table mappings.
Hospital, hangar, accident, and browse-category datasets.
Patient, civilian, worker, responder, and name pools.
Response vehicles, barriers, lights, transport, wrecks, and other scene object pools.
Numbered primary medical and pathology profiles.
Secondary/Halloween health profiles plus status and CARLS message catalogs.

threads.description: Startup, fuel, connection and RescueTrack monitors plus the dispatch triggers (Acceptdispatch 0, Ready dispatch 5 and 6, Stop dispatch 7, NEW DISPATCH, MFD display and delete).
CARLS radio threads: startup, home, connection, popup (Sending request / Request sent), status, group, stop and the DF thread.
Flight monitors: PFT, landing classification, VNE, FLI, Vtoss, Vy, attitude and the engine pairs.

icons.description: Small interface icons (save, hospital, marshaller, status LEDs, wifi, vehicles, bars, options, sliders).
Tablet home and CARLS background images.
